timeline.summary: The dryad Mazena confronts Ruzi after class with a message from Guildmaster Trostani.
timeline.quote: We have an important message from Guildmaster Trostani, and you kept us standing for ages,

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Mazena orders Ruzi to leave today for the Rubblebelt because Trostani sensed a troubling situation.
timeline.quote: You must go to the Rubblebelt. You must leave today.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Cecilee, mute from childhood, suddenly speaks in a beautiful recitation in praise of Selesnya at Vitu-Ghazi, and the dryads call her a conduit to the Worldsoul.
timeline.quote: And then one day Cecilee did speak.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi resolves to break from Selesnya and make destroying Massacre Girl his purpose, knowing Trostani would not permit vengeance.
timeline.quote: If justice was to be done, Ruzi must break from Selesnya and find another way.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Emmara Tandris meets Kaya in the presence of the dormant dryad Trostani, and refuses to commit Selesnya because Ral's plans have been disasters.
timeline.quote: So far, every one has been an unmitigated disaster for the guilds, for Ravnica, and especially for Selesnya.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Mistress Cim awakes and persuades Mistress Ses to restore Trostani's harmony, and Selesnya joins the other guilds against Bolas.
timeline.quote: It is the will of Mat'Selesnya that the Conclave join the other guilds to defeat Nicol Bolas.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kellan explains that Vitu-Ghazi was moved to the moor to recover after the invasion.
timeline.quote: Mat'Selesnya told Trostani that Vitu-Ghazi needed space to put down new root structures

timeline.summary: Trostani appears as three dryads from the oak and agrees to let Kaya consult the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Three dryads, each one an individual, and collectively the singular entity through which the Worldsoul of Ravnica was said to speak.

citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft explains that Vitu-Ghazi's roots could deliver the flowers anywhere in the city.
timeline.quote: The roots of Vitu-Ghazi spread throughout the city.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Trostani's three faces show conflicting reactions.
timeline.quote: She said nothing, only continued looking back, the expressions on her three faces completely out of alignment.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft dismisses Tolsimir's confession, noting he lacked the ability to create the plant.
timeline.quote: Noble of you to try to take the burden of blame onto yourself, but you didn't do this

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft names Trostani as the mastermind behind all the killings.
timeline.quote: Trostani did this, all of it. She's been behind it all along.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: The room is stunned by Proft's accusation that Trostani is the killer and Ezrim asks Kaya if she knew.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Tolsimir insists Trostani cannot have done it because she cannot leave the healing tree.
timeline.quote: she can't leave Vitu-Ghazi while the tree is healing!

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba separates from her sisters, ending Trostani as a unified being.
timeline.quote: Farther and farther from them she pulled herself, until she was, while still attached to the tree itself, an entirely independent entity, Trostani no longer.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Cim says the Guildpact has no way to sever Oba, who remains their sister, and that a rotten branch must be removed.
timeline.quote: Oba remains one-third of us; we have no way to sever her.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Cim says Trostani will go into communion with Mat'Selesnya to learn whether she wants them to remain, and Emmara Tandris will speak for the Conclave.
timeline.quote: Emmara Tandris will speak for the Conclave while we are in communion

timeline.quote: "I was otherwise occupied," said Niv-Mizzet, somewhat stiffly.
